items.title: SpaceX short sellers are running out of bullets as stock rebounds more than 40% off low
items.summary: Short sellers betting against SpaceX are rapidly retreating from the trade, just as the newly public stock rebounds from its post-IPO slump.

items.title: New York City Council announces probe into prediction market platforms’ marketing strategies
items.summary: The New York City Council is investigating marketing practices by prediction market platforms, the office of Council Speaker Julie Menin said on Wednesday.

items.title: EVs dominate China’s car market: 5 takeaways from the country's latest auto sales data
items.summary: BEIJING — Survivors have emerged in China's fiercely competitive car market, which is increasingly dominated by electric-powered vehicles.

items.title: AI computing power is becoming a tradable asset class as CME launches futures contracts
items.summary: Computing power is emerging as a new tradable asset class, with CME Group set to launch the first futures contracts tied to the cost of running the chips that power artificial intelligence.

items.title: Why Jensen Huang’s $500 billion AI financing plan faces a big risk from China
items.summary: Jensen Huang built the world's most valuable company by pioneering the specialized computer chips behind the artificial intelligence boom.

items.title: Polymarket makes moves to get house in order before expected boom times for prediction markets this fall
items.summary: Prediction market platform Polymarket is preparing for what's expected to be a busy fall season for event contract exchanges by making high-profile hires and restructuring its marketing strategy.

items.title: Why JPMorgan is investing big in the 2028 LA Olympics
items.summary: LOS ANGELES — For years, JPMorgan executives have been talking with Olympics organizers about sponsoring the games.

items.title: Is betting on elections using prediction markets illegal? Many states are unsure as midterms approach
items.summary: Wisconsin sent prediction market platforms spinning last month when its election commission released a directive reminding voters that betting on elections — including via trades on event contract exchanges — is illegal in the state, based on a more than 175-year-old law.

items.title: U.S. budget deficit surged in July to highest level since March 2021
items.summary: The U.S. budget deficit soared to its highest monthly level in more than five years amid a surge in Medicare costs and as interest on the federal debt continued to weigh on the nation's fiscal picture, the Treasury Department reported Wednesday.

items.title: 'Nobody wants it': Lettuce prices see record-setting plunge as cyclospora spooks consumers
items.summary: Lettuce prices cratered in July as the multistate cyclospora outbreak pushed diners to shun the leafy green.
